description:
Outcome: Coordinator sees open reports and resolves them (brief.md: First version must 4).
Scope: Open list/detail, resolved status/timestamp/audit, retained report links after allocation changes. Excludes: messaging, task dispatch and reopen workflow.
Acceptance: Resolved reports leave open list; repeated resolve safe; gardeners see only own reports; untrusted content escaped.
Behaviour: Empty open list, permission failures and concurrent update feedback. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Role checks, resolution transitions, malicious content and changed-allocation history tests. Prerequisites: T-012. Assumptions: no reopen workflow.
title: Coordinator reviews and resolves reports
